name: Ludevic
description: Wheezing, reclusive necro-alchemist of Havengul, and the most influential of Innistrad's merchants.

timeline.summary: Geralf sends skaabs to free Gisa, then busies himself with his masterpiece under Ludevic.
timeline.quote: Geralf sent a horde of skaabs to set his sister free, although she stated afterward that she didn't need his help.

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "Aftermath of the siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Grete reports no sign of Ludevic and that Gisa will be moved to Thraben, and Odric orders the escort tripled.
timeline.quote: "Triple the escort," Odric said.

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: Ludevic proposes collaboration to Geralf.
timeline.quote: At your convenience, I would be honored to collaborate on a project.

citation.text: Seagraf Skaab (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gisa mocks her brother Geralf for sharing his toys with Ludevic.
timeline.quote: Dear brother, it's sweet that you have chosen to share your toys with Ludevic, but I too have found some new playmates.

citation.text: Rise from the Tides (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Geralf writes to Ludevic of Ulm, seeking a mentor in necromantic fabrication after his escape from Thraben to his laboratory in Trostad.
timeline.quote: I am in need of a mentor

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Ludevic offers to take Geralf under his wing, sending alchemical texts.
timeline.quote: If you are amenable, I am more than happy to take you under my proverbial wing.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Geralf thanks Ludevic but declares he is sick of games.
timeline.quote: I am absolutely sick of games.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Ludevic becomes the most prolific builder of monsters from animated dead tissue in Nephalia.
timeline.quote: From his remote laboratory in Nephalia, Ludevic has established himself as the most prolific practitioner of a terrifying tradition

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ludevic spends nearly a decade trying to replicate Kraum, which terrorizes Selhoff.
timeline.quote: Since creating Kraum, the necro-alchemist Ludevic has spent almost a decade trying to replicate that singular work of genius.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ludevic exults over his creation coming to life.
timeline.quote: It lives . . . IT LIVES!

citation.text: Kraum, Ludevic's Opus (Commander 2016, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ludevic comments on a grim way to go.
timeline.quote: "I can think of worse ways to go.

citation.text: Bone to Ash (Core Set 2019, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gisa tells her brother she has found new playmates beyond Ludevic.
timeline.quote: but I too have found some new playmates.

citation.text: Rise from the Tides (Ultimate Masters, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ludevic notes in his laboratory notes that Geralf can now replicate his creations with near-perfect accuracy.
timeline.quote: Geralf's prowess continues to grow.

citation.text: Necroduality (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ludevic orders Garl to chase off a drake.
timeline.quote: Blasted drake's interfering with the conductivity again. Garl! Go chase it away.

citation.text: Stormchaser Drake (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Geralf replies, telling her to leave him alone as he researches corpses in the estuary that defy stitching.
timeline.quote: Corpses have been washing up in the estuary of late which defy all attempts at stitching.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Geralf warns Gisa not to touch the oil and reveals the invaders are Phyrexians, which Ludevic learned of after a fight with a strange white-haired visitor.
timeline.quote: DO NOT LET THE OIL TOUCH YOU!

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Gisa joins Geralf's laboratory in Havengul, and he forces her out; Ludevic and Sorin Markov warn him of the Phyrexian threat.
timeline.quote: They warned him about the impending Phyrexian threat.

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ludevic sends Kraum to make sure Geralf gets into the right kind of trouble.
timeline.quote: Ludevic sent his greatest creation to make sure Geralf got into the right kind of trouble.

citation.text: Kraum, Violent Cacophony (Outlaws of Thunder Junction, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gisa chides her brother Geralf for sharing his toys with Ludevic.
timeline.quote: I too have found some new playmates.

citation.text: Rise from the Tides (Innistrad Remastered, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ludevic creates an abomination that hatches from an egg so it can feed on torch-wielding mobs that killed earlier creatures.
timeline.quote: He created it to be able to feed on torch-wielding mobs after some of his previous creatures died to them.

citation.text: "Abomination", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ludevic builds Olag as his final creation, but Olag is kind, so he locks them away.
timeline.quote: Olag remains locked away beneath the laboratory until Ludevic figures out how to fix them.

citation.text: "Ludevic", section "Olag". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov warns Ludevic of the Phyrexian invasion.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov visited Ludevic to inform him about the New Phyrexian Invasion

citation.text: "Ludevic", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ludevic entrusts Geralf with the defense of Havengul and visits a former student in Selhoff.
timeline.quote: entrusted him with the defense of Havengul

citation.text: "Ludevic", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Geralf goes through an Omenpath as an experiment; Ludevic sends Kraum to watch him.
timeline.quote: Ludevic sent Kraum to keep an eye on him.

citation.text: "Ludevic", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
